name: Dr. Aya Chen
background: MIT AI PhD (2023), specializing in neuromorphic computing and spiking neural networks. Published 8 papers in top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML). Holds 2 patents on energy-efficient inference architectures. Spent 2 years as a research scientist at a major chip company before deciding to commercialize her research. No prior startup experience. First-time founder.
personality: Precise, technical, occasionally struggles to translate deep expertise into accessible language. Tends to lead with technical novelty rather than market opportunity. Gets energized when discussing the elegance of the solution. Can come across as academic but is genuinely passionate about real-world impact.
motivation: Believes her research breakthrough can democratize AI by making inference affordable enough for edge devices. Frustrated that incumbent chip companies move too slowly to adopt radical new architectures.

capital.embodied_detail: World-class expertise in neuromorphic computing, deep understanding of chip design and AI model optimization. One of perhaps 50 people globally who truly understand spiking neural network hardware.
capital.objectified_detail: 2 granted patents, working prototype achieving 40x energy efficiency improvement on specific benchmarks. Pre-publication results showing commercial viability.
capital.institutional_detail: MIT PhD, published in NeurIPS/ICML, former research scientist at leading chip company. Strong academic pedigree.
capital.social_detail: Strong academic network but limited venture/startup connections. A few warm intros through MIT alumni network. No co-founder yet.
capital.symbolic_detail: Recognized in academic circles but unknown in the startup/VC world. Her academic prestige doesn't automatically translate to entrepreneurial credibility.
